title: Dimension-dependent symmetry breaking in a diffusive nonlocal interaction model
summary: We study the equilibrium structure and long-time behavior of a nonlinear Fokker--Planck equation with diffusion and nonlocal interactions generated by squared simplex volumes. For $1\leq n<d$, the stationary states are isotropic Gaussian measures, and every solution converges to the equilibrium determined by its conserved mean. At $n=d$, the free energy fixes only the covariance determinant, allowing a continuum of anisotropic Gaussian equilibria when $d\geq2$.
